title: The Dog Night, 2007
logline: Eight years. Back at the dumpster. The bulb is out. The strip draws by the neon.

panels.composition: The dumpster. The bulb: dark, burnt out. The only light the neon's pink spilling around the corner of the building. WOOD and BARNABY, lit pink from one side.

image.prompt: a young man and a gray-muzzled dog behind a bowling alley at night, the bare bulb burnt out, the scene lit only by pink neon spilling around the building's corner, muddy watercolor, no words
close-up of a burnt-out bare bulb in a rusted fixture against a night sky, no words

panels.composition: Wood sitting on the gravel. The dog leaning against him. Pink on one side, dark on the other.

image.prompt: a young man sitting on gravel with a dog leaning against his side, half lit in pink neon, half in darkness, no words

panels.composition: Walking away under the sign. SMALL WOOD LANES, all letters lit, still.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking away beneath a fully lit pink and blue bowling-alley neon sign, watercolor, no words
